summary.text: Ramon Mora Jr. is a South Jersey healthcare worker from Vineland running as an independent for NJ-2. He describes a childhood in Section 8 housing and periods of homelessness, and a back injury that kept him from working for years. His campaign emphasizes affordability, government-accountability reforms, and replacing ICE.

paragraphs.text: Says he was born and raised in South Jersey and has lived there for 31 years; Front Runner New Jersey describes him as from Vineland.

Graduated from Vineland High School and earned an associate degree from Atlantic Cape Community College in 2018; Front Runner New Jersey reports the degree was in nursing. He has worked in healthcare.
Describes growing up in a Section 8 housing neighborhood and experiencing periods of homelessness, including as a teenager and again around age 20.
Says a serious back injury paused his life for years and that he focused on physical recovery for about five years before this campaign.
Says he is running as a Progressive Independent after a falling out with the Democratic Party and that he is not a career politician.

sources.title: Ramon Mora Jr. Runs for Congress as Progressive Independent
